title: 史上最强厄尔尼诺，关你啥事？
title_en: The Strongest El Niño Ever: Why Care?

segments.zh: 太平洋上一大片海，
segments.en: A huge patch of the Pacific

segments.zh: 一年之间，从绿色变成了蓝色。
segments.en: went from green to blue in one year.

segments.zh: 蓝色不是更干净，
segments.en: Blue doesn't mean cleaner.

segments.zh: 而是饭没了。
segments.en: It means the food is gone.

segments.zh: NASA卫星测到，赤道太平洋的叶绿素，
segments.en: A NASA satellite found chlorophyll in the equatorial Pacific

segments.zh: 比一年前少了将近八成。
segments.en: is down nearly 80% from a year ago.

segments.zh: 罪魁祸首：可能是有记录以来最强的厄尔尼诺。
segments.en: The culprit: maybe the strongest El Niño on record.

segments.zh: 今天的问题：太平洋发烧，关你啥事？
segments.en: Today's question: the Pacific has a fever, why should you care?

segments.zh: 认识一下小鳀，一条秘鲁鳀鱼。
segments.en: Meet Andy, a Peruvian anchovy.

segments.zh: 今天，它的饭碗要被端了。
segments.en: Today, his dinner is about to vanish.

segments.zh: 平时，赤道上的信风，
segments.en: Normally, the trade winds along the equator

segments.zh: 一直从东往西吹。
segments.en: blow from east to west.

segments.zh: 它把太阳晒热的表层海水，
segments.en: They push the sun-warmed surface water

segments.zh: 一路推到印尼那边。
segments.en: all the way toward Indonesia.

segments.zh: 就像你对着浴缸一直吹：
segments.en: Like blowing across a bathtub nonstop:

segments.zh: 热水全堆在了另一头。
segments.en: the warm water piles up at the far end.

segments.zh: 西边的海面，
segments.en: So the sea surface in the west

segments.zh: 因此比东边高出几十厘米。
segments.en: sits tens of centimeters higher than the east.

segments.zh: 东边，南美那一侧，
segments.en: In the east, off South America,

segments.zh: 深处的冷水就往上涌。
segments.en: cold deep water wells up to replace it.

segments.zh: 冷水带着营养，养活浮游植物，
segments.en: That cold water carries nutrients that feed plankton,

segments.zh: 浮游植物养活小鳀。
segments.en: and plankton feeds Andy.

segments.zh: 反转一：信风一旦变弱，
segments.en: Twist one: when the trade winds weaken,

segments.zh: 浴缸里的水就晃回来了。
segments.en: the bathtub water sloshes back.

segments.zh: 暖水向东回流，像一床热被子，
segments.en: Warm water flows east like a warm blanket,

segments.zh: 把冷水盖在下面。
segments.en: trapping the cold water below.

segments.zh: 冷水上不来，营养上不来，
segments.en: No cold water, no nutrients,

segments.zh: 海就从绿变蓝。
segments.en: and the sea turns from green to blue.

segments.zh: 秘鲁渔民早就发现，这事常在圣诞节前后出现，
segments.en: Peruvian fishers noticed it often came around Christmas,

segments.zh: 所以叫它“圣婴”，厄尔尼诺。
segments.en: so they called it El Niño, the Christ child.

segments.zh: 小鳀表示：
segments.en: Andy says:

segments.zh: 这礼物我不要。
segments.en: no thanks to that gift.

segments.zh: 反转二：一点点升温，
segments.en: Twist two: how can a little warming

segments.zh: 为什么能搅动全世界？
segments.en: shake up the whole world?

segments.zh: 暖水跑到哪儿，
segments.en: Wherever the warm water goes,

segments.zh: 水汽和大雨就跟到哪儿。
segments.en: the moisture and big storms follow.

segments.zh: 大气就像被挪了暖气片的房间，
segments.en: The atmosphere is like a room where someone moved the radiator:

segments.zh: 整屋的空气都跟着重新流动。
segments.en: all the air starts flowing differently.

segments.zh: 这次有多强？
segments.en: How strong is this one?

segments.zh: 9月21日，关键海区比常年高了3.05度。
segments.en: On September 21, the key ocean region was 3.05 degrees above normal.

segments.zh: 按我国标准，超过2.5度，
segments.en: By China's national standard, anything above 2.5 degrees

segments.zh: 就叫超强厄尔尼诺。
segments.en: counts as a super El Niño.

segments.zh: 美国海洋大气局估计，打破纪录的概率
segments.en: NOAA puts the chance of breaking the record
at about 75%.

segments.zh: 峰值预计在11月到12月，
segments.en: The peak is expected in November or December,

segments.zh: 很可能拖到明年春天。
segments.en: likely lasting into next spring.

segments.zh: 关你啥事？第一：全球会更热。
segments.en: Why care? First: the whole planet gets hotter.

segments.zh: 2016年和2024年两个最热纪录，都紧跟着强厄尔尼诺。
segments.en: The record hot years 2016 and 2024 both followed strong El Niños.

segments.zh: 第二：天气会乱。按气象部门的经验，
segments.en: Second: weather gets weird. Forecasters' experience says

segments.zh: 我国冬天常常偏暖，南方雨偏多。
segments.en: Chinese winters tend to run warm, with more rain in the south.

segments.zh: 1998年长江大洪水，
segments.en: The great 1998 Yangtze flood

segments.zh: 就发生在上一次超强厄尔尼诺之后。
segments.en: came right after an earlier super El Niño.

segments.zh: 反转三：最强，不等于
segments.en: Twist three: strongest doesn't automatically mean

segments.zh: 它是被气候变暖“养大”的。
segments.en: climate change made it stronger.

segments.zh: 哈佛的科学家提醒，一次破纪录，
segments.en: A Harvard scientist warns one record-breaker

segments.zh: 还证明不了这个。
segments.en: can't prove that on its own.

segments.zh: 可它叠加在一个本来就变暖的地球上，
segments.en: But it rides on top of an already warmer planet,

segments.zh: 热浪的起点更高了。
segments.en: so heat waves start from a higher floor.

segments.zh: 友情提示：这些都是概率预报，
segments.en: Friendly fine print: these are probability forecasts,

segments.zh: 不是板上钉钉。
segments.en: not certainties.

segments.zh: 厄尔尼诺不等于一定发洪水，
segments.en: El Niño doesn't guarantee floods.

segments.zh: 还要看季风、副热带高压这些角色。
segments.en: Monsoons and other weather systems get a say too.

segments.zh: 气象部门每个月都会更新，
segments.en: Weather agencies update every month,

segments.zh: 跟着官方预报走就好。
segments.en: so follow the official forecasts.

segments.zh: 等信风重新吹起来，冷水回来，
segments.en: When the trade winds pick up again and the cold water returns,

segments.zh: 海又会变绿。
segments.en: the sea turns green again.

segments.zh: 小鳀现在只盼一件事：
segments.en: Andy is waiting for one thing:

segments.zh: 它的妹妹拉尼娜，快点回家做饭。
segments.en: his sister La Niña to come home and cook.

上一次超强厄尔尼诺之后
